newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur won't raise voting limits.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur won't raise voting limits.

text.p: Winterthur Group has no plan to raise the five percent voting limit on its shares with a view toward the fact that one of Swiss financier Martin Ebner's investment funds has amassed a 14.5 percent stake in its stock, Winterthur Chairman Peter Spaelti said.
Spaelti was responding to journalists questions at the group's annual news conference.
Earlier this month BZ Trust AG said its BK Vision and Stillhalter Vision trusts had built up their holdings in Winterthur to a combined 14.5 percent.
Spaelti also said there has thus far been no discussions as to whether Ebner should take a seat on the group's board

Separately, chief financial officer Erwin Heri said the shares amassed by the Ebner trusts in all likelihood came mainly from smaller shareholders since the group's shares are very widely held. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
